paper_id: SatFusion_ A Unified Framework for Enhancing Remote Sensing Images via Multi-Frame and Multi-Source Images Fusion
title: SatFusion: A Unified Framework for Enhancing Remote Sensing Images via Multi-Frame and Multi-Source Images Fusion
motivation: MFSR lacks HR structural priors → blurry textures; Pansharpening is fragile to noise/misalignment due to explicit upsampling
problem_framing: Jointly fusing k LR MS frames + HR PAN image to reconstruct HR MS image via unified mapping function F(·)
key_insight: Implicit pixel-level alignment via multi-frame redundancy replaces fragile explicit upsampling, breaking both paradigms' bottlenecks simultaneously
method_signature: MFIF module aggregates LR MS frames into HR semantic features; MSIF injects PAN textures; SatFusion* adds PAN-guided spatially adaptive Transformer tokens
evaluation_criteria: PSNR/SSIM/SAM/ERGAS/MAE/MSE across WorldStrat, WV3, QB, GF2 datasets under varying k and scale factor γ
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Performance gains saturate as k grows; while additional frames provide more complementary information, they concurrently introduce marginal noise and redundant content
evidence_for_taste: shatters the inherent MFSR performance ceiling
thinking_moves: 先指出两个孤立范式各自的根本缺陷，再论证其互补性，从缺陷互逆性出发推导统一框架的必然性
把 Pansharpening 的显式上采样重新定位为脆弱环节，用 MFSR 的多帧冗余信息为其提供隐式对齐
通过消融验证单一模块的局限性，强调只有双路径协同才能突破各自瓶颈
将 Transformer 的可变序列长度特性嫁接过来，解决推理时帧数与训练不一致的泛化难题
